name: Sunfeast Smoothies Strawberry with Chia Seeds 300ml
ingredients_raw: Water, milk solids (33.5%), sugar, strawberry pulp (6.3%), strawberry bits (4.9%), banana puree, nata de coco, stabilizers (INS 466, INS 418), acidity regulator (INS 330), nature identical flavouring substances, chia seeds (0.16%), natural flavours and natural flavouring substances, antioxidant (INS 300), sweetener (INS 960) and colours (INS 127, INS 110).
